lines.text: Personal protective equipment. Here's what you'll need to wear on a C.W.P. site.
As a minimum, every job needs:
The site rules, and the risk assessment for your task, may call for more.
And a lifejacket, when you're working near water.
Your PPE must be suitable for the job, correctly fitted, and kept in good condition.
If it's damaged, unsuitable, or missing, tell your supervisor before you start work.
Remember: PPE is the last line of defence. It doesn't replace safe working methods.
Right kit. Worn right. Every time.
